name: tyrion
description: Tyrion — The Calibrated Single-Root ECC Paid Media & Targetology Operating System. 36 specialist agents, 63 skills, 100 atomic knowledge notes, 9 playbooks, 6 context modes, 18 slash commands, 29 deterministic CLI tools, Universal Auto-Router, Native STDIO MCP Server (10 tools), Detailed Targeting Accuracy Engine (6-Status Verification), Live Meta Ads Graph API v26.0 Insights Sync, Breakdown Effect Studio, CAPI v26.0 Builder, Multi-Harness Exporter, and Visual Studio.

hooks_enabled.title: Tyrion hooklari
hooks_enabled.description: Sessiya boshidagi qisqa holat va himoya hooklarini yoqadi. O'chirilsa, Tyrion hech qanday hook ishga tushirmaydi.

hook_profile.title: Hook qat'iyligi
hook_profile.description: minimal, standard yoki strict. minimal — faqat sessiya boshi; standard — ogohlantiradi; strict — qoida buzilsa to'xtatadi. Boshqa qiymat yozilsa standard ishlatiladi.

default_market.title: Standart bozor
default_market.description: Topshiriqda mamlakat, shahar yoki valyuta aytilmaganda ishlatiladigan bozor: global, uz, us, eu, uk, mena, latam, sea yoki in. Boshqa qiymat yozilsa e'tiborga olinmaydi.

meta_access_token.title: Meta access token
meta_access_token.description: Ixtiyoriy. `ads_read` ruxsatli token — interestlarni jonli tekshirish va Insights uchun. Xavfsiz saqlanadi, faqat Tyrion MCP serveriga beriladi. Faqat o'qish so'rovlari yuboriladi.

meta_ad_account_id.title: Meta reklama akkaunti
meta_ad_account_id.description: Ixtiyoriy. Standart akkaunt ID (masalan act_123...). Buyruqda boshqa akkaunt berilsa, o'sha ishlatiladi.
